build-settings.description: Writes Xcode.xcconfig, .swiftlint.yml, Directory.Build.props, mise.toml and pixi platform rows from root package.json and Package.swift

barrels.description: Writes each library's index.ts barrels from its package.json exports and modules

catalog-mirror.description: Writes every default pnpm catalog key into root devDependencies

rust-analyzer.description: Writes .vscode/settings.json rust-analyzer check and rustc rows from the argus .lsp.json rust row

hosting-bindings.description: Writes each .openai/hosting.json d1 and r2 members from its cloudflare.config.ts bindings
